formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P8 — Prospective Method×Reconstructor Support-Surface Census, Outcome-Blind Body-Light Acquisition, Provenance-Stratified Selection-Mechanism Reconstruction, Missing-Covariate Transport Bounds, Geometry Reweighting under Availability Bias, Cross-Year/Source Replication, Source-Contact Firewall & Human-Mechanism Promotion Gate
problem: G7-P7 identifies TS/H1 provenance-axis population sign robustness, but full-population method_family and reconstructor covariates are unavailable. G7-P8 measures whether body-level method/reconstructor observability is itself selectively distributed across the reco.nz 3x3 index population before any stronger geometry transport or human-mechanism claim.

acquisition_design.deterministic_selection: hash-ranked source_id within frozen index-visible support strata; selection manifest committed before any body request
acquisition_design.rare_stratum_policy: if a primary stratum contains fewer than 40 eligible population rows, census all available rows and deterministically redistribute residual slots across remaining strata before contact
acquisition_design.cross_year_constraint: within each stratum, deterministic selection is balanced across coarse year bands where support permits
acquisition_design.exclusion: the frozen 60-body source_ids are excluded from primary acquisition and retained only as an external comparison set

contact_firewall.request_scope: one bounded solve page request per selected source_id
contact_firewall.rate_limit: serial or conservatively bounded requests; no burst scraping
retain_only: minimal source/provenance labels needed to audit selection
contact_firewall.immediate_discard: raw page body after field extraction

primary_readouts: body retrieval availability by frozen population stratum
method_family observability by stratum and year band
reconstructor observability by stratum and year band
difference between prospective body-light sample and frozen 60-body corpus
selection odds / support ratios as descriptive availability quantities, not causal propensities
secondary_readouts: whether missing method/reconstructor is concentrated in provenance classes absent from the frozen 60-body geometry corpus
whether the frozen 60-body method/reconstructor mix lies inside prospective support envelopes

transport_plan.allowed_if_support_positive: post-stratified geometry sensitivity across observed method/reconstructor support cells
transport_plan.zero_support_policy: do not impute geometry into method/reconstructor cells with zero prospective body support

promotion_gate.provenance_axis: P7 CLOSED/PASS for TS/H1 sign only

stop_rules: stop acquisition at the presealed target or earlier only for source-side safety/rate-limit/access failure
do not expand target because observed method/reconstructor distributions look interesting
do not alter strata after body outcomes are observed
implementation bugs may be repaired only if outcome-independent and must preserve the sealed selection manifest
